title: Design tokens
description: The source of truth for a product's design system. Every stack binding (CSS, theme.ts, Theme.kt, Theme.swift) is generated from this file and never edited by hand. Colours are oklch with a hex fallback. Roles reference primitives; themes override roles only.

version.description: Bump on every breaking change to a role or scale.

source.description: Where the direction came from: DESIGN.md, a variant path, a CSS file, or 'brief'.

memorable.description: The one thing a first-time user should remember. Every token serves it.

primitives.description: Named scales. Each step is an oklch value with a hex fallback. Steps run 0 (lightest) to 1000 (darkest) in 50 or 100 increments; a scale needs at least 0, 100, 300, 500, 700, 900, 1000. Derive the neutral from the accent hue at low chroma, never a plain grey.

roles.description: Semantic roles per mode. Dark is designed, not inverted: surfaces lift with lightness, chroma drops 10 to 20 percent, the accent shifts a step lighter.

families.description: Full font-family stacks. Display and body are named faces chosen for this product; neither is Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, Arial, Helvetica, Open Sans, Lato, Montserrat or Poppins. system-ui appears only as a fallback.

tenantDisplayFaces.description: Display faces a tenant theme may choose from. Empty means tenants cannot change the face.

sizes.description: One scale in px. Three to five sizes carry the product UI (label, body, title, display); marketing pages may add one hero size. Line-height and tracking come from the role, not the size.

weights.description: Two weights for UI (regular and one emphasis). A third is allowed only for the display face.

roles.description: Each role names a family, a size, a weight, a line height and a tracking key from the maps above.

scale.description: Every value is a multiple of 8, plus the single 4 half step. Named by index so a later change of base does not rename classes.

radius.description: A hierarchy, not one value: controls, containers, overlays, full. Never the same radius on every block.

rule.const: Elevation above 0 means the element is pressable or it overlays the page. A static block never carries a shadow.

levels.description: 0 flat, 1 pressable at rest, 2 pressable hovered or lifted, 3 overlay (dialog, sheet, popover, toast). Each level gives a shadow per mode; dark mode uses lighter surface plus a thinner shadow, never the light shadow inverted.

duration.description: Milliseconds. instant 80, fast 150, base 240, slow 400, deliberate 700.

stagger.description: Milliseconds between siblings in an orchestrated entrance.

breakpoint.description: Pixels. Above md the layout fills the width: paired columns or a grid, never a half-width column beside empty space.

focus.description: The visible focus ring. Drawn with outline, never removed, contrast 3:1 against every surface.

roleRef.description: Either a primitive reference 'scale.step' or a literal colour value.
